title: Three legs, iii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The first walk to the Lanes. The pup does the whole alley. The box behind the dumpster, where he was found. He sniffs it once and moves on. The strip doesn't say what the box is.

panels.composition: The alley behind the Lanes, day, the dumpster, and behind it a collapsed cardboard box gone gray. WOOD and BARNABY II entering the alley, the pup ahead.

image.prompt: a daytime alley behind a bowling alley with a dumpster and a collapsed gray cardboard box behind it, a thin man and a small three-legged puppy entering with the puppy ahead, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: The pup at the box. One sniff.

image.prompt: close-up of a small three-legged puppy sniffing a collapsed cardboard box once, no words

panels.composition: The pup moving on, already interested in the dumpster's wheel. Wood behind him, looking at the box a beat longer.

image.prompt: a small three-legged puppy moving on to sniff a dumpster wheel while a thin man behind it looks at a collapsed box a moment longer, no words

panels.composition: The alley from the far end: the two of them walking out into the street, the dumpster, the box, the sign above with two letters dark, daylight. Thirteen days before Dog Night.

image.prompt: an alley seen from its far end with a man and a small three-legged dog walking out into daylight, a dumpster, a collapsed box, and a bowling-alley sign above with two letters unlit, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Wordless. One sniff. The box is the box from December 2014.
